# Vendored from alphaXiv/OpenResearch

- Source: https://github.com/alphaXiv/OpenResearch, commit `711f7fc` (2026-11-12), MIT License (see `LICENSE`).
- Contents: the CLI overview (`SKILL.md`) and the agent-skill modules this project follows: experiment tree, results, literature review, reports, figures, paper, create, git, logs.
- Unmodified. They are the reference for the conventions in `charter/OPENRESEARCH.md`. Where they name `orx` commands, those apply when the repo is opened in OpenResearch (`orx up` → import this repository). The `orx-compute`, `orx-instances`, `orx-feedback`, `orx-customize` and `orx-agent-delegation` modules are not vendored; they are tool-specific.
